summary: When asked about her husband's possible run, a spouse points out the grown children and their spouses all have a say.
realLife: Reports said Cheri Daniels opposed a presidential run by Indiana's governor, Mitch Daniels. When she spoke at a party dinner, she said it was not just her, noting that their four daughters and three sons-in-law had a voice. The decision became a whole-family one.
gates: The player has grown children on record.
Press or party is asking whether the player will run.
inGame: Kin ties from a person to grown children in separate households and the household's filing reaction.

turns.what: The children split and one refuses to take part in a campaign.
turns.pulledBy: Old grievances, a child's own public job.
turns.writesBack: A strained kin tie; that child is absent from events.

turns.what: The family meets over a weekend and lands on a plain answer.
turns.writesBack: A decision recorded and shared by the household.

turns.what: One child volunteers while the spouse stays out of view.
turns.writesBack: A volunteer tie from the child; the spouse stays low-profile.
